## Problem and change

Describe the trigger, root cause and resulting behavior. Link the issue and identify any public contract, backend or dependency impact.

## Validation

List exact commands, configurations and results. Explain the regression's failure before the fix, or give primary language-contract evidence when runtime tests cannot demonstrate it. Identify skipped or untested configurations. Documentation-only changes should state which links and commands were checked.

- [ ] Public lifetime, failure, threading and compatibility documentation matches the change.
- [ ] Relevant headers, configured tests and installed consumers were checked.
- [ ] Any performance claim includes comparable revisions and raw measurements.
- [ ] No credentials, personal configuration, build artifacts or unapproved dependency changes are included.
- [ ] Required build and release-validation checks pass before merge.

See [contribution guidance](https://github.com/dugan-dev/UniMemory/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Submit vulnerability details through [private reporting](https://github.com/dugan-dev/UniMemory/security/advisories/new).
